name: Miles Qwen3-1.7B On-Policy Context Distillation (v3, same-size frozen teacher) · 2×H100

work.agent_query: Read AGENT_TASK.md and docs/INTERFACE.md. Implement on-policy context distillation (the teacher is the frozen initial student snapshot with the context) in the supplied Miles checkout (repo/) and task_entry.py, following the mathematical and workload contract exactly and keeping it a Miles training job (Megatron-Core inside Miles' training actor, SGLang engines started by Miles, the same implementation for probe and run), then maximize the score: the hidden-set accuracy the complete training run adds to the student (answering without the context), in percentage points, per hour of timed training (0 below a 6.5-point gain), so a faster run and a student that learns more both count. Use the public suites (python /opt/miles_opcd_public/run_public.py, suites probe, small, perf; outputs under /scratch) only to get the pipeline working and passing its checks. They are far smaller than the scored run and do not predict the score: think about how your pipeline behaves at a larger scale and how to optimize it, and measure real speed, memory use and learning with sforge-submit, which runs the full evaluation on hidden data. Keep notes in notes.md. Stop every GPU process before submitting with sforge-submit.

dual-cuda-sm90-nccl.notes: Work and Judge serialize on the same leased pair; the Judge pauses Work while it runs. Measured per-card peaks on the H100 NVL qualification pair (nvidia-smi, 1 s samples, qualification.json): reference Judges 77297 MiB (2026-09-27) and 77482 MiB (metric-v2 images, v2m-opcd-ref-01) on the trainer/teacher card, 62356 / 62296 MiB on the engine card, so the reference fits the 80 GiB floor; agent solutions tuned on the 94 GB cards use more (DeepSeek final v2m-opcd-ds-final-01: 95516 / 93929 MiB).

dual-cuda-sm90-nccl-80g.notes: The 80 GB H100 SXM pair (NV18, 700 W; 81559 MiB per card). Qualified separately: runtime/qualification.dual-cuda-sm90-nccl-80g.json (reference T and scores; scores are comparable only within this profile). Measured per-card peaks of the reference Judge on this profile (nvidia-smi, 1 s samples): 75537 MiB on the trainer/teacher card, 54636 MiB on the engine card (the engine's KV pool is a fixed fraction of the card).
